```{=html}
<style>
  #title-block-header { display: none; }
  /* break out of Quarto's page column: 88% of the window, max 1500px */
  #home-g { position: relative; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: min(1500px, 88vw); font-size: 1.18rem; }
  /* hero: big logo + tagline + intro */
  #home-g .hero { text-align: center; padding: 0 1rem .25rem; }
  #home-g .hero img { height: min(260px, 26vh); width: auto; max-width: 100%; }
  #home-g .hero .tagline { font-size: 1.6rem; color: #1b4f72; margin: .4rem 0 .3rem; font-weight: 500; }
  #home-g .hero .lead-text { font-size: 1.05em; color: #444; max-width: 980px; margin: 0 auto; }
  #home-g h2 { border: 0; font-size: 1.6rem; margin: 1.5rem 0 .75rem; }
  #home-g .what-we-do > h2 { text-align: center; }
  /* "What we do": 4 cards in one row, icon on top */
  #home-g .features { row-gap: .9rem; column-gap: .9rem; }
  #home-g .feature { border: 1px solid #e3ebf1; border-radius: 8px; padding: .9rem 1rem; height: 100%; background: #fff; }
  #home-g .feature p { margin: 0; text-align: center; line-height: 1.35; }
  #home-g .feature i { display: block; font-size: 1.9rem; color: #5a9bbf; margin-bottom: .3rem; }
  /* "Our Lab philosophy": click to expand in place */
  #home-g details.philo { max-width: 900px; margin: 1.75rem auto 0; text-align: center; }
  #home-g details.philo summary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; cursor: pointer;
    list-style: none; color: #1b4f72; font-size: 1.05rem; }
  #home-g details.philo summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
  #home-g details.philo summary .chev { transition: transform .2s ease; font-size: .85em; }
  #home-g details.philo[open] summary .chev { transform: rotate(90deg); }
  #home-g details.philo summary:hover span { text-decoration: underline; }
  #home-g details.philo p { margin: .75rem 0 0; padding: .9rem 1.25rem; text-align: left; line-height: 1.45;
    background: #f4f8fb; border-radius: 8px; }
  /* Dark mode (light/dark toggle) */
  body.quarto-dark #home-g .hero .tagline { color: #5dade2; }
  body.quarto-dark #home-g .hero .lead-text { color: #ced4da; }
  body.quarto-dark #home-g .feature { background: #2b3035; border-color: #495057; }
  body.quarto-dark #home-g details.philo summary { color: #5dade2; }
  body.quarto-dark #home-g details.philo p { background: #2b3035; color: #e9ecef; }
</style>
```
